recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key studio portrait of a male figure wearing dark sunglasses and heavy gold jewelry, featuring ultra-condensed white sans-serif typography centered over the torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark clothing/background and the bright white central typography
Warmth of the gold jewelry and peach-toned shirt against a cool grey backdrop
Vertical alignment of the text block with the subject's central axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, cropped from the chest up, filling approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertically elongated white text in the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down the gold chains to the central text, and ends at the gold watch on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, uniform grey space in the upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the subject's head tilt.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing and background shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and muted peach (jewelry and inner shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; low saturation in the environment with high saturation in the gold accents.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered on top of clothing and chains

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme vertical contrast (ultra-condensed vs. standard width geometric sans).
graphicDevices: Ornate heraldic crest placed above the text block

preserve: White color for all text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and clean sans-serif aesthetic of the main title.
Provides the necessary geometric stability for the secondary wide-tracked text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up studio portrait of a man with a goatee wearing dark black sunglasses, a black blazer over a peach-colored t-shirt, and multiple thick gold cuban link chains. He is wearing a gold watch on his wrist which is raised towards his chest. The lighting is moody with soft shadows, set against a solid dark grey background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a large, ultra-condensed white sans-serif title in the middle of the frame. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a bold geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing. Place a small, intricate white line-art crest above the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main text vertically elongated?
Is the jewelry rendered with a metallic gold sheen?
Is the background a flat, neutral grey?
Is the text perfectly centered horizontally?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on sunglasses or watch
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the peach shirt.
Verify the gold watch and chains have a consistent yellow-gold hue.
Check that the sunglasses have a realistic dark tint with subtle reflections.
Confirm the vertical stack of elements is aligned to a central axis.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key urban portrait with ultra-condensed centered white typography and metallic gold accents for a luxury hip-hop aesthetic.
